name: Paladin Energy Ltd
content: Paladin Energy Ltd is an Australian-based uranium production company focused on the restart and operation of its flagship Langer Heinrich Mine in Namibia. As a significant player in the global nuclear fuel cycle, the company aims to provide reliable and sustainable uranium supply to support the transition to a low-carbon energy future. Paladin maintains a portfolio of high-quality exploration and development assets in Canada and Australia, positioning itself to capitalize on the growing global demand for nuclear energy and carbon-free baseload power.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

Ian Purdy(Date: 2020 February)

Chief Executive Officer

Mr Purdy is a highly-respected executive with over 30 years’ experience within Australian and international resources companies. He has gained significant experience in the uranium industry through his roles as CFO of Paladin Energy and as a non-executive director of several uranium companies. He has also held senior executive roles with Quadrant Energy, Brookfield Asset Management, Wesfarmers, North Ltd and Mobil Oil Corporation.

Anna Sudlow(Date: 2019 July)

Chief Financial Officer

Ms Sudlow is a corporate finance professional with over 25 years’ experience across the energy and resources sectors. She has held senior finance roles with Woodside Energy and several ASX-listed mining companies. She is a Fellow of CPA Australia and a Graduate of the Australian Institute of Company Directors.

Jon Price(Date: 2021 June)

Chief Operating Officer

Mr Price is a mining engineer with over 30 years’ experience in the resources sector. He has held senior management and operational roles with several ASX-listed companies, including Phoenix Gold and Horizon Minerals. He has extensive experience in project development and operations management.

Jeremy Ryan(Date: 2021 August)

General Counsel and Company Secretary

Mr Ryan is a legal professional with over 20 years’ experience in corporate and commercial law. He has held senior legal and company secretarial roles with several ASX-listed companies in the resources sector. He is a member of the Law Society of Western Australia.

Directors

Cliff Lawrenson(Date: 2019 October)

Non-Executive Chairman

Mr Lawrenson has over 30 years’ experience in the resources and energy sectors. He has held senior executive and board positions with several ASX-listed companies, including Atlas Iron, Ferrum Crescent and GR Engineering Services. He is currently the Non-Executive Chairman of several other ASX-listed companies.

Peter Main(Date: 2019 December)

Non-Executive Director

Mr Main has over 30 years’ experience in the financial markets and resources sectors. He has held senior roles with several investment banks and has extensive experience in corporate finance and capital markets. He is currently a Non-Executive Director of several other ASX-listed companies.

Peter Watson(Date: 2019 December)

Non-Executive Director

Mr Watson is a chemical engineer with over 40 years’ experience in the resources and engineering sectors. He has held senior executive and board positions with several ASX-listed companies, including Sedgman and GR Engineering Services. He has extensive experience in project development and operations.

Melissa Holzberger(Date: 2021 December)

Non-Executive Director

Ms Holzberger is a commercial lawyer with over 20 years’ experience in the resources and energy sectors. She has held senior legal and board positions with several ASX-listed companies and government organisations. She has extensive experience in corporate governance and risk management.

Lesley Adams(Date: 2023 May)

Non-Executive Director

Ms Adams has over 30 years’ experience in the resources and energy sectors. She has held senior executive and board positions with several ASX-listed companies, including Woodside Energy and several mining companies. She has extensive experience in human resources and corporate affairs.
